---
title: "Tsodyks-Markram Neural Mass Model"
subtitle: "Replicating BifurcationKit.jl TMModel.jl with all 4 PO discretization methods"
---

## Overview

This example replicates the [Tsodyks-Markram tutorial](https://bifurcationkit.github.io/BifurcationKitDocs.jl/dev/tutorials/ode/tutorialsBasic1/#Neural-mass-equation) from BifurcationKit.jl's official documentation, demonstrating **all four periodic orbit discretization methods**:

1. **Collocation** — Orthogonal collocation at Gauss points
2. **Trapezoid** — Finite-difference trapezoid rule
3. **Shooting** — Standard multiple shooting
4. **Poincaré** — Poincaré shooting on a hyperplane

The model describes short-term synaptic plasticity with three variables:
- **E**: Mean firing rate
- **x**: Synaptic depression (available neurotransmitter)
- **u**: Synaptic facilitation (release probability)

## Model Definition (Inline YAML with `Dynamics.from_string`)

```{python}
from tvbo import Dynamics

model_yaml = """
name: TsodyksMarkram
description: Tsodyks-Markram mean-field model with synaptic plasticity

parameters:
    J: {name: J, value: 3.07, domain: {lo: 0, hi: 10}}
    alpha: {name: alpha, value: 1.5, domain: {lo: 0.1, hi: 5}}
    E0: {name: E0, value: -2.0, domain: {lo: -10, hi: 2}}
    tau: {name: tau, value: 0.013, domain: {lo: 0.001, hi: 0.1}}
    tauD: {name: tauD, value: 0.200, domain: {lo: 0.01, hi: 1.0}}
    tauF: {name: tauF, value: 1.5, domain: {lo: 0.1, hi: 5.0}}
    U0: {name: U0, value: 0.3, domain: {lo: 0, hi: 1}}

derived_variables:
    SS0: {name: SS0, equation: {lhs: SS0, rhs: "J*u*x*E + E0"}}
    SS1: {name: SS1, equation: {lhs: SS1, rhs: "alpha*log(1 + exp(SS0/alpha))"}}

state_variables:
    E:
        name: E
        initial_value: 0.238616
        equation: {lhs: "Derivative(E, t)", rhs: "(-E + SS1)/tau"}
    x:
        name: x
        initial_value: 0.982747
        equation: {lhs: "Derivative(x, t)", rhs: "(1 - x)/tauD - u*x*E"}
    u:
        name: u
        initial_value: 0.367876
        equation: {lhs: "Derivative(u, t)", rhs: "(U0 - u)/tauF + U0*(1 - u)*E"}

number_of_modes: 1
"""

# Load model from inline YAML string
model = Dynamics.from_string(model_yaml)
```

## Method 1: Collocation (Adaptive Mesh)

Orthogonal collocation with automatic mesh refinement:

```{python}
from tvbo.knowledge.simulation.continuation import Continuation

po_collocation = """
name: tm_po_collocation
dynamics: TsodyksMarkram
free_parameters:
    - name: E0
      domain: {lo: "-10", hi: "1"}
n_inversion: 8
nev: 3
newton_tol: 1.0e-9
bothside: true
branches:
    - name: po_from_hopf
      source_point: "hopf:all"
      bothside: true
      continuation:
          name: tm_po_collocation_po_from_hopf
          ds: 0.0001
          ds_min: 1.0e-6
          ds_max: 0.02
          max_steps: 200
          newton_tol: 1.0e-5
          tol_stability: 1.0e-5
          options:
              - {name: tangent, value: Bordered}
      discretization:
          method: collocation
          parameters:
              - {name: mesh_intervals, value: 100}
              - {name: degree, value: 4}
              - {name: mesh_adaptation, value: true}
          options:
              - {name: jacobian, value: DenseAnalyticalInplace}
"""

cont = Continuation.from_string(po_collocation)
result = model.run('bifurcation-julia', continuation=cont)
result.plot()
```

## Method 2: Trapezoid (Finite Differences)

```{python}
po_trapezoid = """
name: tm_po_trapezoid
dynamics: TsodyksMarkram
free_parameters:
    - name: E0
      domain: {lo: "-10", hi: "1"}
n_inversion: 8
nev: 3
newton_tol: 1.0e-9
bothside: true
branches:
    - name: po_from_hopf
      source_point: "hopf:-1"
      bothside: true
      continuation:
          name: tm_po_trapezoid_po_from_hopf
          ds: 1.0e-4
          ds_min: 1.0e-4
          max_steps: 90
          newton_tol: 1.0e-11
          tol_stability: 1.0e-6
          detect_bifurcation: 2
      discretization:
          method: trapezoid
          parameters:
              - {name: mesh_intervals, value: 150}
      parameters:
          - {name: max_norm_bound, value: 1.0}
"""

cont_trap = Continuation.from_string(po_trapezoid)
result_trap = model.run('bifurcation-julia', continuation=cont_trap)
```

## Method 3: Standard Shooting

Multiple ODE integrations:

```{python}
po_shooting = """
name: tm_po_shooting
dynamics: TsodyksMarkram
free_parameters:
    - name: E0
      domain: {lo: "-10", hi: "1"}
n_inversion: 8
nev: 3
newton_tol: 1.0e-9
bothside: true
branches:
    - name: po_from_hopf
      source_point: "hopf:all"
      bothside: true
      continuation:
          name: tm_po_shooting_po_from_hopf
          ds: -1.0e-4
          ds_min: 1.0e-4
          max_steps: 120
          newton_tol: 1.0e-11
          tol_stability: 1.0e-7
          detect_bifurcation: 3
      discretization:
          method: shooting
          parameters:
              - {name: n_sections, value: 15}
              - {name: parallel, value: true}
          options:
              - {name: ode_solver, value: Rodas5}
"""

cont_shoot = Continuation.from_string(po_shooting)
result_shoot = model.run('bifurcation-julia', continuation=cont_shoot)
```

## Method 4: Poincaré Shooting

Reduced-dimension shooting:

```python
po_poincare = """
name: tm_po_poincare
dynamics: TsodyksMarkram
free_parameters:
    - name: E0
      domain: {lo: "-10", hi: "1"}
n_inversion: 8
nev: 3
newton_tol: 1.0e-9
bothside: true
branches:
    - name: po_from_hopf
      source_point: "hopf:-1"
      bothside: true
      continuation:
          ds: 1.0e-4
          ds_max: 0.02
          max_steps: 50
          newton_tol: 1.0e-9
          tol_stability: 1.0e-6
          detect_bifurcation: 2
      discretization:
          method: poincare
          parameters:
              - {name: n_sections, value: 5}
              - {name: parallel, value: true}
          options:
              - {name: ode_solver, value: Rodas5}
      parameters:
          - {name: max_norm_bound, value: 1.0}
"""

cont_poinc = Continuation.from_string(po_poincare)
result_poinc = model.run('bifurcation-julia', continuation=cont_poinc)
```
